id: \rTake it easy in here. You could get hurt.
en: \rTake it easy in here. You could get hurt.
it: \rVacci piano qui dentro. Potresti farti male.

id: \bThe secrets! The mystery! It's far too much for me to handle.
en: \bThe secrets! The mystery! It's far too much for me to handle.
it: \bI segreti! Il mistero! È davvero troppo per me.

id: \bI collect Shiny Pokémon. My goal is to get them all.
en: \bI collect Shiny Pokémon. My goal is to get them all.
it: \bColleziono Pokémon cromatici. Il mio obiettivo è averli tutti.

id: \bAre you lost? Let me help you.
en: \bAre you lost? Let me help you.
it: \bTi sei perso? Lascia che ti aiuti.

id: \bGoh: \PN! There you are. I was able to catch a ton of Pokémon! Let me show you.
en: \bGoh: \PN! There you are. I was able to catch a ton of Pokémon! Let me show you.
it: \bGoh: \PN! Eccoti qui. Sono riuscito a catturare un sacco di Pokémon! Lascia che te li mostri.

id: \bGoh: I think that's everything here. Should we head back to the lab?
en: \bGoh: I think that's everything here. Should we head back to the lab?
it: \bGoh: Credo che qui abbiamo finito. Torniamo al laboratorio?

id: \bGoh: Perfect. The battle spread the scales from its wings. That should be enough to pass the mission. Let's get out of here.
en: \bGoh: Perfect. The battle spread the scales from its wings. That should be enough to pass the mission.  Let's get out of here.
it: \bGoh: Perfetto. La lotta gli ha fatto perdere delle squame dalle ali. Dovrebbero bastare per superare la missione.  Andiamocene da qui.

id: \rI'm sorry. I didn't know you were with Project Mew.
en: \rI'm sorry. I didn't know you were with Project Mew.
it: \rScusami. Non sapevo che facessi parte del Progetto Mew.

id: \bNew ruins have opened up. How fasinating.
en: \bNew ruins have opened up. How fasinating.
it: \bSi sono aperte nuove rovine. Che cosa affascinante.

id: \bGoh: Do me a favor and battle this Volcarona.
en: \bGoh: Do me a favor and battle this Volcarona.
it: \bGoh: Fammi un favore e lotta contro questo Volcarona.
